title: San Diego, California, Police Reportedly Relied on a Flock License Plate Reader Image in Mistaken Arrests
summary: Police in San Diego, California, reportedly mistook a red Alfa Romeo photographed by a Flock Safety automated license plate reader for a car linked to an attempted carjacking. Officers also relied on a witness identification. They arrested driver Ariel Beltran, passenger Hugo Parra, and a third man. Parra spent nearly a month in jail before his charges were dropped. Parra and Beltran later sued the city and officers.
